Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified OTRAG’s country as the Democratic Republic of the Congo by conflating its test/launch site in Zaire/DRC with its headquarters and country of origin. Credible sources indicate OTRAG was a West German company based in Stuttgart/Neu-Isenburg, Germany. This misinterpretation leads to an incorrect country comparison with Kaufland (Germany).
